The only thing I wish is there were a couple of plain ones in the package.  They were all prints and it would nice to have a couple solid colors.

Cotton material allows for heat to escape on hot days which is great when you have curly thick hair.  Would or will buy more.

reviews.t: A life saver if u are sick of rubberband headaches
reviews.x: I bought these to keep my hair out of my face before and after surgery and in preparation for the inevitable menopause that would hit me post surgery. I was not going to take hot flashes lightly and let me tell you these kept the hair out of my face and off my neck. Also I have a relatively large head and these did stretch to a comfortable fit after a few wears. I wash them in a lingerie bag and they have held up.

I am so happy with these headbands. I got the "flower mix" pack and they are all so pretty! They fit my head perfectly and aren't too tight at all. They are a large width so you can cover all of the top of your head if you want or you can scrunch them and cover less. Really versatile and so cute!

I am fussy and critical when it ones to headbands particularly, and since these were a quantity, it was a real roll of the dice.  These are great.  They fit snugly.  I have worn one for hours without it getting loose!  I like the tie dye of these as well and soft and well made.

reviews.t: What to wear when COVID19 prevents you from seeing your hairdresser
reviews.x: I work out a lot outside running bootcamps. These headbands keep the sweat out of my eyes AND match my outfit. They have also been incredibly helpful to just throw on and cover up bad hair days. Love the colors. Great value for the money.

Colors are as pictured, I love them. Great accessory to add to my collection. Had a shipping glitch, but the seller was accommodating and sent  another out after waiting about 7 days to presumably verify I had not received it.

reviews.t: Just what I was looking for
reviews.x: They are comfortable and not tight at all. They are soft cotton. Nice bright and colorful. I bought some other bandana style and they are harder, tighter on the head, and a lot stiffer than these.

claims.text: Customers frequently praise the soft, lightweight cotton fabric and its comfort and sweat absorption.
Many reviewers find the headbands fit well and stay in place without slipping, though a few say they need barrettes or pins to hold them.
Several customers love the colors and tie-dye prints, with some wishing for plain options or noting a missing color.
A notable minority complain the headbands run extremely small and provide insufficient coverage.
Reviewers repeatedly highlight the great value and quality for the price.
